baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled قَالَ at words 1 and 3 frames رَبُّكَ at word 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: One voiced saying reports a second, lordly saying, so the answer arrives as an authoritative utterance that settles possibility rather than as detached explanation.

activation_trace.role: Voiced articulation supplies the doubled speech frame and makes the answer audibly enacted.
Lordship and mastery give the embedded saying its authority over the stated possibility.

changed_reading.before: The verse merely reports that God says the event is easy.
changed_reading.after: The doubled saying stages the reply itself as the authoritative act that closes the question of possibility.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: هَيِّنٌ ... خَلَقْتُكَ مِن قَبْلُ ... لَمْ تَكُ شَيْئًا at words 7-14.
baseline_models.mechanism: Ease is grounded in an earlier creation: temporal priorness and negated occurrence/thinghood establish that a present entity once lacked reportable existence, supplying an internal precedent for the promised act.

activation_trace.role: Lightness and ease state the divine-side evaluation of the act.
Creative bringing-into-existence supplies the precedent on which ease is argued.
Temporal precedence locates the addressee's creation as an already realized comparison.
Occurrence and presence in time define the state explicitly negated before creation.
A knowable, reportable thing supplies the category whose prior absence sharpens the precedent.

changed_reading.before: Easy is an unsupported assertion of unlimited ability.
changed_reading.after: Easy is argued from the addressee's own prior transition from no reportable thinghood into created presence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: رَبُّكَ, خَلَقْتُكَ, and شَيْئًا at words 4, 9, and 14.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus branches combine lordly completion, growth, creative measuring, and will-related thinghood: creation can be read as measured, nurtured realization rather than only instantaneous production.

activation_trace.role: Repair, nurture, and completion cast the Lord as one who brings a process to maturity.
The split growth branch contributes nourishment and emergence to the lordly title.
Measuring and proportioning make creation an ordered realization.
Will related to a thing supplies the intentional pole of its realization.

changed_reading.before: Creation is a bare production of an entity.
changed_reading.after: The Lord's ease includes measuring, nurturing, and realizing what will takes up as a thing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The split focus inventory places ease and weakness under the same focus form. Context makes weakness bodily and human in 19:4; 19:9 relocates the evaluation with عَلَىَّ, turning the same pressure into lightness on the divine side.

activation_trace.role: Ease and lightness state the explicit divine-side value.
The split weakness branch keeps human loss of force latent inside the focus anchor.
Explicit weakening of force supplies the human condition that the focus ease reverses.

structural_cues: The complaint وَهَنَ الْعَظْمُ in 19:4 precedes هُوَ عَلَىَّ هَيِّنٌ in 19:9.
The prepositional عَلَىَّ marks whose scale of difficulty governs the answer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one mapped weakness branch across 19:4 and the split inventory of 19:9; I infer a human/divine reversal. A live alternative is simple thematic contrast without an intended lexical echo.

changed_reading.before: Easy contrasts only abstractly with human impossibility.
changed_reading.after: The answer converts the addressee's named weakness into its inverse evaluation: weak on the human side, light on the Lord's.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated childlessness marks a cut-off generative line, while advanced age has reached its extreme; the glad report of a young boy places a new beginning directly against those closures. The focus ease therefore operates at the blocked transition from no offspring to youth.

activation_trace.role: Ease supplies the force that makes the blocked transition light.
Interruption of offspring first establishes generative closure.
News that opens the face with joy turns closure toward announced arrival.
The boy's youth supplies the new beginning opposite advanced age.
Repeated interruption of offspring intensifies the closed-line condition immediately before the focus.
Old age supplies the exhausted temporal end from which the promised youth must emerge.
Extremity in old age hardens the apparent biological terminal point.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from promise in 19:7, through a doubled impossibility claim in 19:8, to the ease claim in 19:9.
Youth and extreme age occupy opposing ends of the same life process.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies interruption of offspring, extreme age, glad news, and youth; I infer a closure-to-opening mechanism. The live alternative is that these details merely amplify generic power.

changed_reading.before: The prior creation proof answers an abstract doubt.
changed_reading.after: The proof targets a specific closed process: the Lord can reopen generation where offspring and age both appear terminal.

context_deltas.mechanism: Context denies a prior namesake, then the focus repeats priorness while citing the addressee's own creation. The answer relocates precedent: no comparable named child is required, because the relevant earlier case is the questioner's passage from non-thinghood.

activation_trace.role: Temporal priority marks the earlier creation now offered as precedent.
Creative origination identifies what the relocated precedent actually is.
Naming as designation makes the promised child's lack of a prior namesake explicit.
The earlier occurrence of temporal priorness supplies the exact echo that the focus redirects.

structural_cues: لَمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُ مِن قَبْلُ سَمِيًّا in 19:7 is answered by خَلَقْتُكَ مِن قَبْلُ in 19:9.
Both clauses use negation and مِن قَبْلُ but attach them to different subjects.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated construction and the naming branch; I infer that 19:9 changes the domain of precedent from peer comparison to personal creation. The alternative is an unmarked repetition of ordinary temporal language.

changed_reading.before: The addressee's earlier creation is a generic example of divine ability.
changed_reading.after: The answer concedes the child's lack of prior counterpart and substitutes the addressee's own origination as the exact kind of precedent that matters.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gift, inheritance of knowledge or virtue, transformation into a desired state, and the later bestowal of book and judgment make creation purposive. The focus's measured creation becomes precedent not only for producing a child but for forming one into a continuity-bearing role.

activation_trace.role: Measuring and proportioning anchor purposive formation in the focus verb.
Nurture and completion make formed capacity part of lordly creation.
Uncompensated gift casts the promised life as bestowed rather than mechanically produced.
Transmission of knowledge, book, or virtue supplies the continuity the created child is asked to bear.
Making into a state supplies deliberate formation toward being pleasing.
The written book supplies the concrete content later entrusted to the promised child.
Sound wisdom supplies the mature capacity bestowed while the recipient is still young.

structural_cues: The request for a gifted heir in 19:5-6 precedes the creation precedent in 19:9.
The promised child receives book and judgment in 19:12, completing the requested continuity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gift, inheritance, state-making, book, and judgment; I infer that prior creation licenses purposive formation into office. A live alternative is that 19:9 proves existence only and the later endowments are separate gifts.

changed_reading.before: Created you before proves only that another body can be produced.
changed_reading.after: Prior creation also precedents measured formation into a role able to carry knowledge and continuity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The doubled divine saying in the focus is followed by a visible sign, suspension of ordinary human speech, and communicative gesture. Speech therefore does not remain information: it crosses into bodily event and nonverbal disclosure.

activation_trace.role: Voiced saying anchors the communication whose efficacy the following sequence tests.
A manifest sign turns the verbal promise into an observable marker.
Intelligible speech between people supplies the channel that is temporarily withheld.
Gesture supplies a nonverbal channel after ordinary speaking is suspended.

structural_cues: 19:9 doubles قَالَ; 19:10 names a sign and withholds speaking; 19:11 replaces it with gesture.
The communication sequence moves from divine voice to embodied sign to human indication.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered change of channels; I infer that divine saying is performative, becoming the condition it announces and signs. The alternative is that the silence is only subsequent confirmation.

changed_reading.before: The focus speech communicates a proposition about ease.
changed_reading.after: The focus speech initiates an event whose proof appears by reorganizing speech itself into sign and gesture.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because قَبْلُ in 19:9 is grammatically temporal while B007 is the branch image of one who receives a child at birth. It remains anchored because the focus root carries that branch and the context supplies womb, interrupted offspring, and actual birth; downstream prose must preserve the temporal meaning and present reception only as a secondary birth-image overlay.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مِن قَبْلُ at word 11 inside خَلَقْتُكَ ... وَلَمْ تَكُ شَيْئًا.

activation_trace.role: Temporal precedence preserves the actual syntax and primary sense of the focus expression.
Receiving a child at delivery supplies the branch-distant image of being received into thinghood.
The womb supplies the bodily chamber from which birth-reception proceeds.
Interrupted offspring makes successful reception at birth the precise blocked event.
Actual birth and delivery complete the context image that activates the remote focus branch.

changed_reading.before: God cites only an earlier chronological act.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the earlier act is pictured as the addressee's own first delivery into thinghood, a birth-reception that precedents receiving another child.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-ayah model is surprising because it reads the later birth-death-raising sequence back into a verse about prior creation. It remains valid as a state-transition model anchored in خَلَقْتُكَ, تَكُ, and شَيْئًا; downstream prose should call it a contextual pattern, not claim that 19:9 explicitly names resurrection.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: خَلَقْتُكَ ... لَمْ تَكُ شَيْئًا at words 9-14.

activation_trace.role: Creative origination supplies the first transition into existence.
Occurrence in time supplies the state variable negated before creation.
Reportable thinghood supplies the state reached by the first transition.
Birth supplies a later entry into embodied life.
Loss of force and life supplies the reverse phase boundary.
Rousing what is still supplies renewed transition after death.
Living being supplies the resulting state after rousing.

changed_reading.before: The addressee's first creation is a one-time analogy for unusual birth.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, non-thing to created thing is the first instance of a context-wide grammar of transitions through birth, death, rousing, and life.

strongest_changes: The split ه و ن inventory turns 19:4 human weakness into the inverse divine evaluation of ease in 19:9.
The repeated مِن قَبْلُ relocates precedent from a comparable namesake to the addressee's own origination.
Gift, inheritance, book, and judgment make prior creation a precedent for purposive formation, not body production alone.
The doubled saying unfolds into sign, suspended speech, and gesture, making the focus utterance performative.
summary.what_was_special: Split mappings exposed the ه و ن/و ه ن reversal and the ر ب ب/ر ب و growth model, while the repeated ق ب ل construction supplied an exact contextual hinge between unprecedented naming and prior creation.
remaining_uncertainties: The split-root weakness and growth echoes may be associative activations rather than intended lexical effects.
The later role and life-cycle sequences may not legitimately specify the immediate force of خَلَقْتُكَ.
The birth-reception branch of ق ب ل is image-only here; temporal syntax remains primary.
